option_relations.rationale: Symptomatic apical periodontitis is a distinct diagnosis from chronic apical periodontitis, though both involve inflammation of the periapical tissues. The provided leaf is specifically 'Chronic Apical Periodontitis'.

Persistent apical periodontitis is a broader category that can include chronic apical periodontitis, but it is not equivalent to the specific leaf provided. The option also specifies a cause (complex canal anatomy) which is not directly related to the leaf's name.

Persistent apical periodontitis is a broader category that can include chronic apical periodontitis, but it is not equivalent to the specific leaf provided. The option also specifies a cause (previously incomplete endodontic therapy) which is not directly related to the leaf's name.
The option 'Chronic apical periodontitis' is identical to the provided leaf 'Chronic Apical Periodontitis'.
